name: TypeGPU effects
description: GPU video effects written with TypeGPU: water ripples, an RGB shift, halftone dots and an old CRT. Drawn with WebGPU; nothing in it runs as a program.
author: Uncut

shaders.name: Ripple
shaders.description: Water ripples rolling out from a point, with a glint on the crests.

shaders.name: RGB shift
shaders.description: Red and blue pulled apart along a slowly turning angle, breathing with time.

shaders.name: Halftone
shaders.description: Print-style ink dots on paper, sized by how dark the picture is.

shaders.name: CRT
shaders.description: An old tube screen: rolling scanlines, a barrel curve, an RGB mask and a flicker.
